config_name: iPad 11-inch — A16, 6GB RAM, 128GB, 11" Liquid Retina + Magic Keyboard Folio

specs.display_type: Liquid Retina IPS LCD (non-laminated, anti-reflective coating, no ProMotion)
specs.keyboard_notes: Magic Keyboard Folio included in price: detachable scissor keyboard with 14-key function row, adjustable hinge — NO trackpad
specs.pen_support: Apple Pencil (USB-C) ~$119 or Apple Pencil 1st gen ~$149 — not included; no Pencil Pro/2 support, no hover

battery.notes: 28.93Wh cell. Apple claims 10h web/video Wi-Fi; users report ~8-9h mixed real-world use.

price.notes: Tablet-only $649.00 (apple.com/ca, verified 2026-11-24) + Magic Keyboard Folio $329.99 (BBY 16567047). BBY frequently discounts the tablet itself ($635.99, SKU 19464683). Wi-Fi+Cellular variant +$200 ($849 tablet) omitted per tablets-file precedent. Pencil not included.

offers.name: Apple iPad A16 11" 128GB with Wi-Fi 6 (11th Generation) - Blue

reviews.quote: The affordable tablet lags behind in the most important area. Pros: fast SoC, hardly any heat dissipation, premium case. Cons: thick bezels, a slow 60 Hz screen, the panel is not completely laminated, only a 12-month guarantee, only a few Bluetooth audio codecs, only USB 2.0.

praises: Cheapest way into the full iPad app ecosystem — A16 keeps everyday apps and games smooth for years (r/ipad, BBY reviews)
Landscape 12MP front camera makes it the best-value video-call tablet; Center Stage keeps you framed while carrying it
Magic Keyboard Folio's detachable design + 14-key function row is genuinely laptop-like for typing-heavy use
Battery holds 8-9h of real mixed school/work use — all-day every day (BBY reviews)
USB-C finally accepts standard hubs/SSDs/monitors (display out works) unlike old Lightning iPads
complaints: Non-laminated display has a visible air gap — pen bounces above the line and reflections sit on top of the image (top gripe in every review)
No Apple Intelligence: A16 is excluded from Apple's AI features, so this is the one current iPad without them
USB-C is USB 2.0 (480Mb/s) — transferring 4K video off the iPad crawls
Requires the old Apple Pencil 1st gen (awkward Lightning-adapter charging) or Pencil USB-C; no Pencil Pro
Magic Keyboard Folio has NO trackpad — pointer control needs a separate Bluetooth mouse

design_philosophy: Apple's price-anchor iPad: the same iPadOS experience as the Pro line at half the money, cut back only where Apple thinks buyers will forgive (lamination, USB speed, AI silicon). With the Magic Keyboard Folio priced in it is the cheapest real laptop-substitute Apple sells, aimed at students, families, and business fleets.
